desc: Write a function to identify connected components and the cycle in each component of the functional graph.
For each component, identify the cycle nodes and the trees attached to them (nodes flowing into the cycle).

Implement a DP to compute $f(u, v)$ for all nodes $u$ and $v \in [1, M]$, where $f(u, v)$ is the number of valid assignments for the subtree rooted at $u$ (in the reversed graph) given $x_u=v$. Use prefix sums to optimize the transition.
For each component, compute $G_c(v) = \prod_{c_j \in \text{cycle}} f(c_j, v)$ for each $v \in [1, M]$.
Compute the final answer as $\sum_{v=1}^M \prod_{\text{components}} G_c(v) \pmod{998244353}$.
Read input, run the algorithm, and print the result.
